name: Sichuan
notes: Sources: Fuchsia Dunlop, The Food of Sichuan (2019); Chengdu Municipal Bureau of Commerce, 中国川菜 / Sichuan (China) Cuisine (2010); Wang Gang (王刚) cooking videos. Hunan's duojiao and Cantonese oyster/hoisin are the nearest decoys; dairy, basil, lime, fish sauce and coconut mark drift to Italy, Thailand or Vietnam.
